note: Generated by running the real backend on a disposable database. Regenerate after any contract change; the diff IS the change. Ids and timestamps are replaced with stable placeholders so two runs produce identical files. No live database was touched and no real customer, address or supplier product appears here.

late_schedule_change.description: The plan was built, then another stop was added. The revision still matches, so only the basis fingerprint catches it. Confirmation is refused with 23514 and the reason.

conflict.message: The day's work changed after this plan was built, so confirming it would load for a schedule that no longer exists. Rebuild the plan.

crew_permission_failures.description: What a crew gets when it tries an owner-only call. Both are 42501 and both carry a sentence explaining the split.

build_load_plan.message: Only the owner builds a load plan: it reads the whole day's schedule and decides what every job needs.

authorise_load_exception.message: Only the owner authorises a departure from the plan. That is what "owner-authorised" means.

duplicate_retry.description: The same operation key twice. The second call returns the first result with replayed true and creates no second revision — which is what a lost response looks like from the client side.
